title.narrative: Education for peace and peaceful coexistence among cross-border communities from Gisenyi (Rwanda) an

description.narrative:
The project aims to reduce mistrust between communities in the sub region, especially between people living in the diocese of Nyundo (Rwanda) and Goma (DRC).
The aims will be achieved by enhancing conjoint peace activities and initiatives. In the implementing project region area, especially in the eastern DRC, there are still armed groups that threaten the security of the population. This feeds the suspicion between the Congolese and Rwandan people.
This project plans to organise peace caravans and walks to deliver the message of peace to the cross-border communities and others key stakeholders. There will also be brainstorming workshops, as well as radio broadcast programs to help overcome the mistrust between communities. All this will enable the targeted people and communities have a good understanding that mistrust between them destroys and prevents sustainable development.
